formulas.name: True-RMS meter
f: Vrms = √[(1T)∫ v2 dt] (thermal or computing type)
notes: Where: T = period, v = instantaneous voltage
Tip: Average-responding meters are calibrated ×1.11 and read wrong for non-sinusoidal waves; true-RMS reads correctly.

formulas.name: Crest factor & form factor
notes: Where: CF = crest (peak) factor, FF = form factor
Tip: A true-RMS meter has a rated maximum crest factor (e.g. 3).

formulas.name: Spectrum analyzer
f: resolution bandwidth (RBW) sets the smallest separable
notes: Tip: Swept (superheterodyne) or FFT type. Used for harmonics, noise, distortion.

formulas.name: Wave / distortion analyzer
notes: Where: V₁ = fundamental rms, V₂, V₃ … = harmonic rms values
Tip: Harmonic distortion analyzer rejects the fundamental.

formulas.name: Power-quality analyzer
f: Measures V, I, P, Q, S, pf, THD, sags/swells, flicker,
notes: Tip: Unbalance % = (max deviation from average / average) × 100.

formulas.name: Recorders
f: X-Y recorder: plots one variable vs another (servo pens)
magnetic tape recorder: direct (AM), FM and digital (PCM)
notes: Tip: FM recording works down to DC; direct recording does not.

formulas.name: Digital data recorder / data logger
f: Samples, digitises and stores signals at a set rate
notes: Tip: Storage needed = channels × samples/s × bits × time.

formulas.name: Digital storage oscilloscope (DSO)
notes: Where: BW = bandwidth
Tip: Scope bandwidth should be 3–5 × signal frequency.

formulas.name: Displays
f: LED: emits light, fast, more power
LCD: modulates light, very low power, slow
notes: Tip: LCD needs AC drive (DC damages it).

formulas.name: Temperature transducers
notes: Where: R<sub>T</sub>, R₀ = resistance at T and at the reference, α = temperature coefficient (/°C), ΔT = temperature rise
Tip: Thermocouple: widest range; RTD: most accurate/linear; thermistor: most sensitive.

formulas.name: Pressure transducers
notes: Tip: Piezoelectric: dynamic pressure only (not static).

formulas.name: Flow transducers
notes: Where: Q = flow rate, Δp = pressure drop, B = field (T), l = pipe diameter (m), V = flow velocity (m/s)
Tip: Electromagnetic flowmeter needs a conducting fluid; no moving parts.

formulas.name: Displacement & acceleration
notes: Where: ε = permittivity, A = plate area, d = gap; m = seismic mass, k = spring stiffness, a = acceleration
Tip: Piezo accelerometer for vibration; LVDT for small displacements.

formulas.name: Strain gauge bridge
notes: Where: GF = gauge factor, ε = strain
Tip: Full bridge also compensates temperature.

formulas.name: Noise measurement
notes: Where: SNR = signal-to-noise power ratio; k = 1.38 × 10⁻²³ J/K, T in K, R in Ω, B = bandwidth (Hz)
Tip: Sound level: dB = 20 log(p/p<sub>0</sub>), p<sub>0</sub> = 20 µPa.

formulas.name: Data acquisition system (DAS)
notes: Where: S/H = sample-and-hold
Tip: Multiplexing lets one ADC serve many channels.

formulas.name: Sample-and-hold
f: aperture time, acquisition time, droop rate
notes: Tip: Needed when the signal changes faster than the ADC conversion time.

formulas.name: ADC types & conversion time
notes: Where: n = bits
Tip: Resolution = V<sub>FS</sub>/2<sup>n</sup>; quantisation error = ±½ LSB.

formulas.name: DAC
notes: Where: V<sub>ref</sub> = reference voltage, n = number of bits
Tip: R-2R needs only two resistor values — preferred.

formulas.name: Data transmission / telemetry
f: Voltage, current (4–20 mA), frequency and digital telemetry
notes: Tip: 4–20 mA: live zero at 4 mA detects wire breaks; unaffected by line resistance.

formulas.name: PLC
f: Input scan → program execution → output update (scan cycle)
languages: ladder, FBD, ST, IL, SFC (IEC 61131-3)
notes: Tip: Scan time = time for one full cycle (ms). Ladder logic mimics relay circuits.

formulas.name: Smart meter
f: Measures kWh, kVAh, kVARh, maximum demand,
notes: Where: AMI = advanced metering infrastructure
Tip: Enables remote reading, prepaid billing, tamper detection, demand response.
